name: slideshow
text: Start a slideshow of the pictures or folders given.

name: convert
text: Write each input as PATTERN and exit, without a window. * stands for the input's name without its extension; the extension picks the format (png, jpg, webp, bmp, tga, ppm, qoi, wbmp). Folders in PATTERN are created. Example: --convert=out/*.webp

name: resize
text: Fit within W × H pixels (proportions kept), make the width W or the height H, or scale to N percent.

name: long
text: Make the long side N pixels.

name: shrink-only
text: With --resize or --long: leave pictures that are already small enough.

name: rotate
text: Turn clockwise by the angle, or upright by the EXIF orientation.

name: flip
text: Mirror left to right (h) or top to bottom (v).

name: strip
text: Leave EXIF and XMP out of the output (a color profile stays).

name: overwrite
text: Replace output files that exist (otherwise a number is added to the name).
